independent_reference.source: (1) Hand-derivation in tools/testkit/golden/derivations/physarum-deposit-step1.md §§ 1-3: with a zero initial trail, the sense step returns identical zero readings, the rotate step is a tie (canonical tie-breaker: keep current heading), and each agent moves +1 along its cardinal heading and deposits 5.0. (2) Jones, J. (2010), 'Characteristics of pattern formation and evolution in approximations of Physarum transport networks', Artificial Life 16 (2), 127-153, DOI 10.1162/artl.2010.16.2.16202, § 3 Table 1 — canonical parameter set and the five-component update order. (3) Python independent re-derivation by tools/testkit/golden/generator/physarum_deposit_step1.py.
